The '''Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps''' ('''NRSFC'''), also known as the '''Royal Naboo Starfighter Corps''', was part of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Security Forces]] dedicated to protecting the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|citizens]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] which fought at the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was best known as the '''Naboo Planetary Defense''' ('''NPD''').

==History==
[[File:NRSFC.png|thumb|left|150px|N-1 starfighters of the NRSFC.]]

The Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps were formed by [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]], as a means to renegotiate their contracts with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] from a position of strength.<ref name="DPn">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

The pilots of this small corps flew [[Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps/Legends|Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering]] Nubian-1 J Starfighters, commonly known as the [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|Naboo Starfighter]]. As implied by the name, the N-1 J used dual Nubian radial sublight [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2]]-series [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] for [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] coordination and navigation.

Although the NRSFC was strictly made up of volunteers, the pilots trained and drilled on a regular basis in their fighters. Their primary task was to serve as honor guard for the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] or [[Senator/Legends|Senator]], but the NRSFC saw their fair share of action in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends#Battle in space|Naboo space battle]], where they destroyed a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] with the help of young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

The Space Fighter Corps comprised at least five [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]]: [[Alpha Flight (Naboo)|Alpha Flight]], [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]], [[Delta Flight]], [[Echo Flight]], and [[Victor Flight]]. At the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], all three were under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]], who flew as [[Bravo Leader/Legends|Bravo Leader]] during the orbital part of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].

After the Battle of Naboo, the Space Fighter Corps began accepting [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] applicants into its ranks. One such recruit, [[Toba]], founded a new squadron comprised entirely of Gungan pilots, called [[Iron Cesta Flight]]. Iron Cesta Flight used the new [[G-1 starfighter]],<ref name="CSWEICF">{{CSWECite|II|115|Iron Cesta Flight}}</ref> designed for extended periods of independent operation and sustained combat,<ref name="CSWEG1">{{CSWECite|I|304|G-1 starfighter}}</ref> to police the Naboo system and hunt [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] preying on the traffic between the planet and the newly established [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]] colony.<ref name="CSWEICF" />

The [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the Space Fighter Corps were known as a devil-may-care group, many of whom gained experience in off-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] pirate fighter groups. While serving in the Space Fighter Corps, few pilots ever left the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]], though some of the more skilled&mdash;or merely lucky&mdash;were chosen to fly royal escort duty to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

Members of Bravo Flight, including [[Porro Dolphe/Legends|Porro Dolphe]], escorted [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] [[J-type diplomatic barge/Legends|diplomatic barge]] to Coruscant during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], during which they suffered losses in an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|I'm a pilot, Naboo Defense is what I'd like to do.|A spacer, to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]]|<ref name="SWG:PfT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Legacy Quest: "Patrolling for Typho" in the Naboo system}}</ref>}}
During the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Naboo Planetary Defense was mostly tasked to deal with [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the Naboo system.<ref name="SWG:PfT" /><ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the NPD [[Dogfight over Naboo|defeated]] the [[Naboo pirates]] and their leader [[Rezunin Starwing]].<ref name="SWG:SWI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Star Wing Intercept" in the Naboo system</ref>

By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95-AF4 Headhunter]] had become the RSF primary starfighter. Other vessels included [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] for [[Ace/Legends|ace]] pilots, [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]]s, [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class starships]] and [[Unidentified transport class|deep space scanner transports]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> Nevertheless, N-1 starfighters were still in operation during the [[Rally on Naboo/Legends|Uprising on Naboo]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
